title: SA-2026-044: a site's take step runs the gate from the patched tree; run it from the pre-patch tools and refuse a patch that changes tools/ or adds a symbolic link
note: Found by security@php.newsroom on 27 October 2026 (nightly pass). Every repository's pages.yml: the gate job applies the edition's patch, then runs tools/gate.py and tools/pages_gate.py from it; the refuse-list covers .github/, .git/ and VERSION only. The patches are built in the press's edition job, which also runs build/ code released without security's review. A .github/ change in each repository and in the press: the editor's go, security's review of the branch. THE EDITOR'S GO, 28 October 2026 (in security's session): go for the .github/ change in each repository and the press, with security reviewing the branch before dev merges it. CONDITION (the editor): dev first takes into account the fixes dev has made to the edition and deploy process since 27 October (board dev-0005, dev-0008; deploys take the newest edition on a push; pages.yml restored; every site's gate is the press's newest) and confirms the issue is still relevant before building the change. Security's check on 28 October at 23:xx UTC, site's pages.yml on dev: still relevant (the take step's refuse-list is still .github/, .git/ and VERSION only, and the gate still runs from the patched tree, line 65). Note for the design: the process now ships tools/ to the sites through the edition on purpose, so a refusal of any change to tools/ would block that; the fix is to run the gate from the pre-patch copy, and to accept a tools/ change only when the edition says it carries a press release that security reviewed.
